en-US.description: Upload an accessory image and a model image to create a commercial accessory try-on visual.
en-US.empty.productImage: Upload an accessory product image first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.generationMode.advanced.desc: Adds richer material response, reflections, occlusion, and scene-aware styling for more premium try-on results.
en-US.generationMode.standard.desc: Provides a stable and accurate accessory try-on result for standard production usage.
en-US.label: Accessory Try-On
en-US.upload.modelImage.help: Choose a model photo where the target accessory region is clearly visible and the pose is easy to preserve.
en-US.upload.productImage.help: The product image can be a catalog shot or a model shot, but only the selected accessory category will be applied.
en-US.category.bag.desc: Handbags, shoulder bags, tote bags, crossbody bags, and similar bag products.
en-US.category.belt.desc: Belts, waist chains, and other waist-worn accessories.
en-US.category.necklace.desc: Necklaces, chokers, collar chains, and similar neck accessories.
en-US.category.glasses.desc: Optical glasses, sunglasses, and similar eyewear.
en-US.category.wristwear.desc: Bracelets, bangles, cuffs, watches, and wrist-worn accessories.
en-US.category.hat.desc: Caps, bucket hats, beanies, and other headwear.

zh-CN.description: 上传配饰商品图和模特图，一键生成配饰试戴商拍图。
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置

zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.generationMode.advanced.desc: 增强材质反射、遮挡、贴合与环境氛围适配，适合更高级的商拍试戴效果。
zh-CN.generationMode.standard.desc: 强调稳定、准确的配饰试戴结果，适合常规商拍生成。
zh-CN.label: AI试戴
zh-CN.upload.modelImage.help: 建议模特图中目标配饰区域清晰可见，姿态和构图便于保持。
zh-CN.upload.productImage.help: 商品图可以是纯商品图或模特图，但只会提取所选品类对应的配饰进行试戴。
